description: Couche régionale de synthèse de l'analyse des enjeux pour l'étude d'implantation d'éoliennes en Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.datara.gouv.fr. As part of the development of the mapping of areas favourable to wind development, DREAL has put in place a methodology to obtain a territorial analysis of the issues for wind development. It is a layer resulting from the crossing of other geographic layers illustrating the level of stake across the entire regional territory. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Regional synthesis of the analysis of the stakes for the study of the installation of wind turbines in Auvergne-Rhône-Al" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
